thread:
alex_k: FYI i'm about to merge the runtime part of the /v2/generate routing changes. quick async Qs about contract+model selection before merge.

sana: drop em here, can do a quick pass. :eyes:

alex_k: question1: client can provide `model` + `routing_hints: {region:"eu-west-1", tier:"standard"}`. desired behavior plan:
1) try exact model in requested region
2) fallback to exact model in other regions (same tier)
3) compatible variant (quantized) in requested region
4) compatible variant other regions
5) model-family fallback
is that ordering okay, and should `tier` influence skipping lower-tier variants?

leo_p: ordering looks fine but make tier explicit: if `tier=high` don't consider low-tier variants unless `allow_tier_fallback=true`. also prefer same-region compatible variants over other-region exact models when latency SLOs matter (configurable policy).

jamie: note: `pin_version=true` must block version cross-fallbacks. enterprises rely on exact model version.

alex_k: i'll document that: `pin_version` blocks version changes; `allow_tier_fallback` gates tier downgrade. next: response shape when fallback happens. current runtime returns `meta.served_model` only. customers want region for billing and SLA.

leo_p: add `meta.served_region` (nullable). add `meta.fallback_reason` enum: NONE | REGION_UNAVAIL | VARIANT_USED | TIER_DEGRADED | VERSION_PIN. include `meta.requested_region` if we want to make audit easier.

sana: request: include `meta.fallback_chain` as short array of attempted model ids (limit 3). but hide it by default behind `debug_trace=true` to avoid leaking catalog churn.

jamie: agreed. default response small; `debug_trace=true` opt-in.

alex_k: contract error semantics: runtime currently returns 409 when `model` is incompatible (e.g., streaming requested but model lacks streaming). prefer? 409 seems ok.

leo_p: keep 409 with `error.message` "requested capability not supported by specified model" and `error.details.supported_capabilities` list.

jamie: 404 for unknown model id, 403 for region disallowed by org policy.

alex_k: CI ask: i'll add an integration test that mocks `model_catalog` returning quantized variant and simulates region outage; assert `meta.fallback_chain` + `meta.fallback_reason` values. pinging @ci-bot to run `runtime-integration/fallbacks` after merge.

ci-bot: queued runtime-integration/fallbacks :gear:

sana: one more API param: `model_selector.preferences` (list) — how should it interact with `model` + `routing_hints`? if `model` present we treat `model_selector` as a tie-breaker for variants only; if absent, `model_selector` guides family selection. add to docs + SDK notes.

alex_k: noted. i'll add docs + unit tests for selector precedence. also asking @sana for a quick docs PR review before i merge.

sana: will review in ~30m. :thumbsup:

alex_k: thanks all. merging in ~1hr unless objections.
